verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec for Stripe Billing, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI path returned 404. llms.txt, markdown docs, the MCP server and the CLI are related machine-readable or agent surfaces, not an API specification, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
